zh-CN.title: 表情包保持原生展示
items: 表情包不再继承个性化气泡边框
合并消息圆角不会影响表情包外观
所有气泡主题下都保持透明无气泡展示

en.title: Native sticker presentation
items: Stickers no longer inherit personalized bubble borders
Grouped-message radii no longer affect sticker artwork
Every bubble theme now keeps stickers transparent and bubble-free
